extracted.name: Simple Cranberry Spinach Salad
extracted.description: This is a simple salad that can be made in minutes. I use a light raspberry-walnut vinaigrette dressing.
instruction_lines: Combine the spinach, cranberries, walnuts, vinaigrette, and Romano cheese in a large bowl; toss until spinach is evenly coated. Serve immediately.
